contract:
Contract ListBookHistory::listOverDueBook(uid: String): Set(BookCopy) {
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->one(u: User|u.UserID = uid) and
		User.allInstances()->forAll(u: User|if u.UserID = uid 
		then u.LoanedBook.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		u.LoanedBook->forAll(l: Loan|if l.IsReturned = false and
		l.OverDueFee>0.0 
		then l.LoanedCopy.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		else true 
		endif ) 
		else true 
		endif )
	postcondition:
		let u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User|x.UserID = uid) in
		let overdueLoans: Set(Loan) = u.LoanedBook->select(l: Loan|l.IsReturned = false and
		l.OverDueFee>0.0) in
		overdueLoans->projectSet(l: Loan|l.LoanedCopy)
}
